title: Con-cat-enate: pilot overview
description: Short overview of the concatenate amateur cat Combined with Beacons Bevcyc and demo 0.01 plan

methods.name: Proposed decomposable action-sequence cat agent with ROS-style checkpoints
methods.description: The pilot sketches a cat agent built from decomposable action sequences using ROS-style action checkpoints.
methods.evidence: We’d like to create a cat ( a decomposable action sequence agent ) ( using ROS style action checkpoints )

methods.name: BEACONS: pulse-and-response-table emulation of a social cortex
methods.description: Tagged objects are assigned pulses with a response table so the cat can decide how to respond, hedge or prepare toward each object.
methods.evidence: SocialCortex –esque emulation; thru attaching PULSES (+response table)

methods.name: BEV-CYC: inherited-then-learned chains of decomposable behavior nodes
methods.description: Behavioral drives are represented as node chains, hardcoded from birth and then edited by learning, decomposed down to muscle-tension decisions.
methods.evidence: As a chain of nodes that each node can be decomposed All of them are first inherited (hardcoded from birth) And all of them are then learned

methods.name: Time-limited SIM resolution with 'quickcalc' free-energy shortcuts
methods.description: Each simulation is resolved within a time limit and updates parameters; low-novelty SIM types are converted to quickcalc formulas over a free-energy range.
methods.evidence: Quickcalcs are a way to simplify the simulation run onto a FE % calculation - Via active inference.

key_findings: The authors summarise the pipeline as: get vision input, label/tag/process, combine with CYC, form a SIM, learn the SIM outcome, and update.
The authors state the methods are currently handwritten and optimization is still in progress.
The authors state they lack a consistent automated formula but believe they can produce a full behavior table for any requested video or activity.
key_findings_evidence: Get vision input  Label , tag , process  Combine with CYC  Becomes SIM  Learn SIM outcome  Update
Methods are currently handwritten, optimization still on work
We are not good at automizing Or making a good math formula For consistency! But we are pretty certain we are able to make Full behavior table for any video / activity that is requested!

summary_provenance.method: Evidence-grounded extraction from full_text.md: every method and finding carries a verbatim quote from the paper text, mechanically verified to occur in full_text.md (whitespace/ligature-normalized) before merge.
